Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the proteomic profiling of exosomes. While exosomes are an enrichment of a specific vesicle type, they do not map to the specific PTM-based or targeted modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) defined in the provided ontology for Stage 4 routing. The acquisition is explicitly DDA and quantification is label-free (MaxLFQ).

scope: we defined the protein signature of exosomes released by RB tumors (RBT) and vitreous seeding (RBVS) primary cell lines by high resolution mass spectrometry
Exosomes were purified from culture media after 3–4 days culture by sequential centrifugation
The final pellet was resuspended in PBS or specific lysis buffer for proteomic analysis

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of purified exosomes isolated via sequential ultracentrifugation from cell culture media. While exosomes are membrane-derived, they are the primary isolated entity analyzed by MS, mapping to the extracellular vesicle scope.

primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between diseased and healthy or unaffected controls.
evidence: we characterized the proteomic cargo of exosomes isolated from RB cell lines established from solid tumor tissue in the retina (retinoblastoma tumors (RBT)) and from tumor seeding in the vitreous humor (RBVS).
The comparison between the three RBVS cell lines highlights 1657 proteins shared

The significant proteins were plotted using a Volcano plot (Figure 6A) and an unsupervised hierarchical clustered HeatMap (Figure 6B). A total of 246 proteins were differentially expressed: 205 were up-regulated in RBT and 41 in RBVS-derived exosomes.

RBT serves as the baseline/control group for the more aggressive RBVS state. A paired analysis was also performed for a single patient (RBT1 vs RBVS1).
